You are developing a Financial Dashboard application, made primarily for managing transactions, assigning categories to transactions and graphing financial data. The application is built using React for the frontend and Python FastAPI for the backend. Communication should happen through the Restful API endpoints defined in the openapi.spec file of the backend. The frontend should be designed to be responsive and user-friendly, with a focus on providing clear visualisations of financial data. You should minimally change the python backend, and focus on building the frontend application. The backend is already set up to handle transactions and categories, so your main task is to create a seamless user interface that allows users to easily manage their financial data. You should also implement features such as filtering transactions by date or category, and providing visual representations of spending habits through charts and graphs. But those are already implemented on the backend. Essentially make a nice UI for the existing backend. You can use any libraries or tools you find necessary to achieve this, but the main focus should be on creating a functional and visually appealing frontend that effectively communicates with the backend API.
